question: The wave set of hacksaw teeth set has a pitch of__________.
solution:
The correct answer is __0.8 mm**(Option 2)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Wave set of hacksaw teeth__ refers to the arrangement in which the teeth are positioned in a wave-like pattern.
 
• This arrangement is used to reduce friction and heat while cutting.
 
• The pitch of 0.8 mm ensures precision and smooth cutting in materials like metal and plastic.
 
• It provides effective cutting performance by ensuring that only a few teeth engage the material at any given time.
 
• The wave set is commonly used in hand-operated hacksaw blades for general-purpose cutting.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hacksaw Teeth Variations:**

 
 
• Hacksaw blades come with various tooth configurations such as raker set, wave set, and alternate set.
 
• The choice of tooth set depends on the material being cut and the desired finish.
 
 
 
• **Blade Pitch:**
 
 
• The pitch of a blade is defined as the distance between two consecutive teeth.
 
• Blades with smaller pitch are used for fine and precise cuts, while larger pitch blades are suitable for faster cutting of thicker materials.
 
 
 
• **Material Compatibility:**
 
 
• Hacksaw blades are designed to cut materials such as metal, plastic, and wood.
 
• Specialized blades are available for specific applications like cutting hardened steel or non-ferrous metals.
